activeSlice.scope: Add shadow-only Preference-aware EEI V2 reranking: real exploration allocation, diversity enforcement, manipulation-risk blocking, saturation controls, Preference State affinity and recommendation explanations. Existing production Hunter EEI remains authoritative.
successCriteria: Final shadow selection allocates a bounded exploration share derived from Brand Preference State and EEI policy rather than configuration-only metadata.
Core, adjacent and exploration candidates remain deterministic and explainable.
Strong negative preference matches and manipulation-risk candidates are blocked before final selection.
Topic concentration, source diversity and saturation controls are enforced without mutating production Hunter behavior.
Recommendation explanations expose why selected, evidence, Brand fit, uncertainty and user control.
No provider credentials, scheduled execution, production Hunter wiring, UI changes, opportunity persistence or production enablement are introduced.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass before certification.
